working_definition: Author type 'LC10d' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).
searches_performed: 'immature lobula columnar neuron LC10d' (new term, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-11-02)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult lobula columnar neuron LC10d (Özel et al., 2021).

justification: 'LC10d' is FBbt:00111748 'lobula columnar neuron LC10d'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so its immature form FBbt:00053674 (FBbt #2219, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a lobula columnar neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature LC10d term (used until FBbt #2219 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10B. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 4 to 6, with less dense arbors in 5B than in layers 4, 6 or 5A (in contrast to LC10a). Presynaptic sites are observed in layers 4 and 6 (less numerous than LC10a in layer 3 and LC10b in layer 6). Its arbor is much smaller than LC10b. There are around 84 cells of this type.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053674 'immature lobula columnar neuron LC10d' (exact match).
